review_focus:
Item P61 (#620), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P61 Window-mechanics commands typed and moved out of `commands.rs`

- Branch: `epic/p61-window-commands`. Lanes: D, S, U, P, C. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P55.3, P57 (desktop-ui owns the selection the open commands now take as parameters), P58.1 and P59 (A17: removing `check_ai_files_changed` needs every other flag-on reader of the App's `tab.ai` gone, and the snapshot's `ai` field leaves in P58.1 and the GitHub senders in P59), P60.2 (it holds D and U, so it runs after both tracks; it brings in P60.1).
- **Goal:** the 27 commands that stay direct return `Result<T, ErError>` with protocol types, and none of them lives in a file P62.2 deletes.
- **Done when:** the browser webview (9), terminal (4), OS launch and reveal (6), export (3), `start_window_drag`, `detect_dev_url`, `line_commits`, `fetch_github_image` and `dev_log_filter` commands are typed; the ones in `commands.rs` (15), `commands/line_commits.rs` and `arena_commands.rs` (`dev_log_filter`) move into a new `crates/er-desktop/src/direct/` module, one file per group (window, OS launch and reveal, terminal, export, line commits, dev log), and take `DesktopState` (P52.1), so P62.2 can delete `commands.rs`, the `commands/` directory and `arena_commands.rs` whole; `browser_webview.rs` and `github_image.rs` stay where they are; `open_in_editor`, `open_in_vscode` and `open_source` take the path and line from desktop-ui in both builds, since desktop-ui knows the selection in both (today they read `tab.selected_diff_file()` and `current_hunk`, `commands.rs:1678`–`:1693`); `reveal_er_folder`, `line_commits` and the export commands take the `TabKey`, and each keeps a flag-off twin on the App path until P62.2, because er-service is an optional dependency (`v1-service = ["dep:er-service"]` in `crates/er-desktop/Cargo.toml`) and a flag-off build has no `TabContent`: with the flag on, `reveal_er_folder` reads `er_dir` from the content (flag off: `app.tab().er_dir()`, `:2448`), `line_commits` resolves its target from the content's diff section (flag off: `resolve(app.tab(), &path)`, `commands/line_commits.rs:240`–`:242`), and the export commands render the content (flag off: `render_markdown(app.tab(), …)`, `commands.rs:10668`, `:10685`, `:10709`); the flag-on export takes er-protocol's export options with the same JSON shape in place of `ExportOpts`, which flattens the `ui`-gated `er_engine::export::ExportOpts` (`export.rs:14`, `:22`), and both arms share one renderer: the engine's markdown rendering (`render_markdown`, `crates/er-engine/src/export.rs:88`) and its options type (`er_engine::export::ExportOpts`, `:23`) are extracted into the always-compiled half (lane S, as 2a.1 extracted steps) over exactly what the renderer reads, and no diff rows: the branch name (`tab.current_branch`, `:89`–`:93`), the AI state (`tab.ai`'s questions, notes, GitHub comments, review and checklist, `:109`, `:134`, `:159`, `:183`, `:220`) and the directory it loads the UI annotations from (`load_ui_annotations(&tab.comments_dir())`, `:208`), which is `er_dir`: `TabState::comments_dir()` returns `self.er_dir()` (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:2168`–`:2170`); the flag-on arm takes the branch from the content's `ResolvedTab` (`TabContent.tab.current_branch`; `crates/er-engine/src/tab_identity.rs:142`), the AI state from the content's AI section, and the UI-annotation directory and the default `export.md` directory of `export_review_to_file` and `export_to_agent` (`commands.rs:10687`, `:10710`) from its context's `er_dir` (`TabContent.context`, `er-service/src/content.rs:33`; `TabContext::er_dir`, `er-service/src/protocol.rs:486`), never `TabContext::comments_dir`, which is the GitHub-comment bucket, the PR bucket on a PR tab (`protocol.rs:487`–`:488`, filled from `github_comments_dir()` at `commands.rs:6839` and `er-service/src/effect.rs:240`); er-desktop's exclusion step (`resolve_exclusions`, `crates/er-desktop/src/export.rs:53`, which takes `&TabState`) gets a `TabState`-free signature over the same AI state and stays in er-desktop; `er_engine::export` keeps a `ui`-gated `render_markdown(tab)` wrapper and a re-export of the moved options type, and er-desktop maps er-protocol's `ExportOptions` onto the moved type; the export parity test compares the two arms; the tick's `check_ai_files_changed` goes, since the export was the last flag-on reader of the App's `tab.ai` (A17), and P52.1's export-reload test now passes through `ReloadSidecars`; `export_to_agent` stops returning `AppSnapshot` and its run shows in `jobs` (P60.2); the names among them that fail the rule leave the allow-list; their callers use the generated types.
- **Planted breaks:** restoring one to `Result<_, String>` fails `er::command_shape`; leaving a typed name on the allow-list fails as stale (P51), and so does re-adding one; an `open_source` that reads the App's selection fails the held-App-mutex test; an export rendered from `TabState` fails the export parity test against the flag-off output, whose fixture is a local PR tab in Branch view with a git remote that resolves its owner and repo, so its `er_dir` (the branch view bucket) differs from its comments directory (the PR bucket), which the test asserts before it renders; the fixture has a non-empty branch and a UI-annotation file in `er_dir`, so a flag-on arm that drops the branch header (plant), drops the UI-annotation section (plant) or reads the UI annotations from `context.comments_dir` (plant) fails it, and an `export_review_to_file` with an empty path that writes `export.md` under `context.comments_dir` (plant) fails its path assertion; with the App locked, a flag-on `line_commits`, `reveal_er_folder` and `export_review` each answer, and a flag-on arm that resolves from `app.tab()` fails the held-App-mutex test; removing `check_ai_files_changed` before the export moves fails P52.1's export-reload test.
- **Fallback split:** P61.1 the move and the typing; P61.2 the flag-on arms of `reveal_er_folder`, `line_commits` and the export, the renderer extraction and the tick duty.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
